Hello Margaret, just a note to say the council has scheduled the pavement works for next Tuesday, so there may be some noise from about 8am. They've said it should be finished in a day.

If the van blocks your drive, let me know and I'll have a word with them. I've organised a space in front of ours if you need it.

labels.notes: Clean British message; "organised" is correct en-GB spelling.
